lines.description:
ADVANCE PAYMENT — 50% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE
First instalment under Contract CON/TNDK/SQ118/2026 (Revision 1) for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of:
1. FREEZER ROOM — 10.00 m (L) x 9.50 m (W) x 5.00 m (H), 475.00 m3, operating at -18 C to -22 C, in 100 mm PUF sandwich panel to walls and ceiling (290.00 sqm) with ceiling suspension steel; one (1) No. sliding door 2000 x 2500 mm with heated frame and gasket; one (1) No. Dorin (Italy) AU2-H2201CS 22 HP air-cooled condensing unit with a Gunay (Turkey) GNE 350.6C2 unit cooler on R404A; copper piping, Armaflex insulation, electric defrost and insulated drain line with heating tape; digital control panel with all safeties; internal vapour-proof LED lighting, door frame heater and complete electrical works; and all coving, angles, sealing, fasteners and accessories.
2. EPOXY FLOOR COATING — food-grade epoxy coating to the freezer room floor, 95.00 sqm, including cleaning, grinding, priming, coving at the panel-to-floor junction and silicone sealing.
3. PREPARATION ROOM — 9.50 m (L) x 5.00 m (W) x 3.00 m (H), 142.50 m3, unrefrigerated, in 50 mm PU sandwich panel to walls and ceiling (134.50 sqm) with ceiling support steel; one (1) No. aluminium door 900 x 1900 mm complete with hardware; and all aluminium coving, corner angles, silicone sealing, fasteners and accessories.
Contract value QAR 110,000.00 — this invoice covers 50% thereof.

notes: PAYMENT SCHEDULE. Contract value QAR 110,000.00 — 50% advance on signature of contract QAR 55,000.00 (this invoice); 30% on completion of the panel work and before delivery of the machine QAR 33,000.00; 10% on installation of the machine and before the epoxy floor coating QAR 11,000.00; 10% on successful testing, commissioning and handover QAR 11,000.00.

REVISED INVOICE. This invoice is issued in revision of our invoice of the same number dated 18 October 2026 and supersedes it in full; the earlier document is withdrawn and should not be acted upon. The revision gives effect to the amended payment terms at clause 4 of Contract CON/TNDK/SQ118/2026 Revision 1. The contract value, scope and specification are unchanged.

Payment due on presentation of this invoice. Payment may be made in cash, or by cheque or bank transfer to the account shown above; cheques to be crossed and drawn strictly in favour of the account name given. Kindly quote invoice INV-284/2026 as the reference.

PROGRAMME. Under clause 5.1 of the Contract, time runs from the later of the date of signature and receipt of this advance in cleared funds. Material delivery is 3 to 4 weeks from that date, with a total project duration of 45 to 55 days subject to site readiness. Material will be ordered on receipt of this payment.

SITE SURVEY. Under clause 2.3 of the Contract, a site survey will be carried out and the final room dimensions confirmed in writing before any fabrication is put in hand. Any change arising from that survey will be dealt with as a Variation under clause 8.

INSULATED FLOORING IS NOT INCLUDED to either room. Both rooms are erected on the existing concrete floor, and the epoxy specified is a surface coating and not an insulating layer. Clause 10 of the Contract records the advice given on operating a freezer room over an uninsulated slab and the risks that follow. We will be pleased to quote separately for an insulated floor construction, and recommend that this is considered before fabrication begins.

BY OTHERS, as set out in Schedule 3 of the Contract: civil works, foundations and structural support, including the structure from which the ceiling panels are hung; the main power supply and the cable run from the main distribution board to the cold room control panel; the drainage point within 3 m of the evaporator drain outlet; and all permits and approvals.

WARRANTY: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, doors and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the compressor, coils, electrical components and controls from the date of commissioning, as set out in clause 12 of the Contract.
